RESULT: DONE
CHANGED: web/app/mindmaps/[key]/board/WaitingOnYou.tsx
TESTS: `npx tsc --noEmit` (run from web/) -> no output, no errors. I added no test for this component, so the response-shape mismatches are still not covered by an automated check.
CHECKLIST:
#1 FIXED WaitingOnYou.tsx:97-103. The branch now reads `data.committed === true`, which removes the row and calls `bumpRefresh`.
#2 FIXED WaitingOnYou.tsx:16, 79, 142-143. The row type now uses `memory_id`, the field the backend sends. `memory_id` is the work item's node id (`work_items.py` and `workflow_moves.py` pass `node_id` as `memory_id`). The board-item join, the title fallback and the Sign URL all use it, so `title` is never undefined. I did not touch the backend.
#3 FIXED WaitingOnYou.tsx:102-103. The count and minimum come straight from `signed_count` and `signoff_min`. The guessed fallbacks and the extra `bumpRefresh` are gone.
#4 NOT FIXED I found no existing web test setup in my scope. I made no `tests/` change because the task says the harness runs none.
NOTES:
- The backend sends `memory_id` rather than `node_id`. WP4-T5 should pin `memory_id` (or add `node_id` to `PendingSignoffOutput`) before this panel's field name is treated as settled.
- The team-wide pending list can include requests for other maps. The panel doesn't filter them out, so a Sign on one of those will probably show the error banner.
